audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Mucolipidosis type IV and Lisch epithelial corneal dystrophy are both recorded as caused by the gene MCOLN1 [e_e94d022ab291] [e_19ce71376434].
Both gene links are curated, meaning they come from Orphanet and OMIM [e_e94d022ab291] [e_19ce71376434].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this causal gene, at confidence 0.9 [e_14697036abcf].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_14697036abcf].
For mucolipidosis type IV, two curated features are recorded as very frequent, an abnormality of sugar chain handling and a build-up of fats called gangliosides [e_d427e9ef5fcc] [e_57bf08b506ce].
These edges do not show how one gene leads to two different conditions, and they list no symptoms for the corneal condition [e_14697036abcf] [e_19ce71376434].
They also show no studies, no treatments and no patient groups [e_e94d022ab291].
